flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/plusintegration/controllers/PlusIntegrationController (responses to PLUS), workflows/furnish/dto/FurnishResponse, workflows/furnish/helpers/FurnishabilityChecker ('already updated' message only in the eService review). Other repos: no code
note: Demo remark in the sheet (PLUS API not pulling data, suspected DB connection drop) cannot be verified from the repo. There is no 'particulars already updated' alert to PLUS on the PLUS path. Responses to PLUS are only 'Notice is furnishable' / a reason message for stage-PS-advisory-notice-not-found (check) and 'Success' + new stage or a failure message (furnish/redirect). The only similar message constant ('Furnished ID is already the current offender (same role)', FurnishabilityChecker.java:76) is used only in the eService review. There is no outbound client to PLUS in ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi, or ocmseserviceapi; the PLUS UI is not in the repo.
recommendation: Do not claim. There is no 'already updated' alert to PLUS. PLUS responses only carry the furnishable result or the furnish/redirect result. The PLUS UI that shows the message to the user is not in the repo.

steps.step: OCMS builds an alert that the hirer/driver particulars are already updated for the notice
steps.detail: The closest text is MSG_FURNISHED_ID_EXISTS_SAME_ROLE 'Furnished ID is already the current offender (same role)' and the codes HIRER_ALREADY_UPDATED / DRIVER_ALREADY_UPDATED (FurnishabilityChecker.java:76, 286-291). Both are only produced by runAllChecksAndCollectFailures for the eService review (see OCMS41.54), never from the PLUS path (PlusIntegrationController.java:136-168).

steps.step: OCMS sends that alert to PLUS
steps.detail: Responses to PLUS are only: /plus-furnish-redirect-check replies 'Notice is furnishable' or the furnishable-check reason message (PlusIntegrationController.java:80-84); /plus-furnish and /plus-redirect reply success with the new stage (150-157, 199-206) or HTTP 422 with a failure message (159, 208). There is no 'already updated' case. There is no outbound call or callback to PLUS: a search for 'plus' in ocmsadminprivateapi and thirdpartyapi finds no PLUS client, and ocmseserviceapi only has read endpoints.

steps.step: The PLUS user knows the particulars are already updated for the notices in OCMS
steps.detail: Showing the message to the user is the job of the PLUS UI, which is not in these six repos: cannot verify from the repo. From the OCMS side, there is no 'already updated' message that could be shown (see steps 1-2).
